In the diagram shown above, $m∠1={35}^{∘}$ and $m∠4={111}^{∘}.$ Determine the value of $m∠2+m∠3.$
question.worked_solution:
We have two pairs of vertical angles, and we know that vertical angles are congruent and therefore have the same measure. So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠1 & =m∠2, \\ m∠3 & =m∠4.\end{aligned}
$$

We are told that $m∠1={35}^{∘}$ and $m∠4={111}^{∘},$ so we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{35}^{∘} & =m∠2, \\ m∠3 & ={111}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠2+m∠3 & ={35}^{∘}+{111}^{∘} \\  & ={146}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
